title: ComputeDocResult
description: Output of `model compute` — the runtime computation over a document INSTANCE: what each computed field becomes (compute), via the native-safe interpreter by default (`--kernel` for the A12 kernel, JVM only). Read-only — the input --instance is never modified. The INPUT --instance is the same nested tree `model eval` takes (under "fields": repeatable group = array of rows, field = its text value).

computed.description: each computed field and what the kernel made of it, in kernel order

outcome.description: value (computed a value) | cleared (computed nothing, e.g. an empty operand) | error

value.description: the computed value when outcome is 'value' (or a partial on 'error'); absent when cleared
